finding: The stem says a covered mortgage and the explanation unconditionally says must receive three business days before consummation. Section 1026.19(f) includes a timeshare timing exception and a bona fide personal financial emergency waiver; covered alone does not exclude these. The intended A remains the correct general-rule answer.
